rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying there are many or a large quantity of something.

example.english: This supermarket has an abundance of fresh fruit.
example.traditional: 呢間超市有好多新鮮水果。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 sin1 seoi2 gwo2

rows.note: Use this casual expression for a conspicuously large heap or pile of items.

example.english: There is an abundance of documents piled on the desk.
example.traditional: 張枱上面擺住一大堆文件。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 soeng6 min6 baai2 zyu6 jat1 daai6 deoi1 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for a plentiful supply of usable resources, opportunities, time, or money.

example.english: We have an abundance of time left, so there is no need to rush.
example.traditional: 我哋仲有大把時間，唔使急。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 daai6 baa2 si4 gaan3 m4 sai2 gap1

rows.note: Use this noun when abundance means wealth or accumulated assets rather than a quantity of things.

example.english: He accumulated an abundance of wealth through his own efforts.
example.traditional: 佢靠自己累積咗唔少財富。
example.jyutping: keoi5 kaau3 zi6 gei2 leoi5 zik1 zo2 m4 siu2 coi4 fu3
